title: Planning asks a secrets gate before the start for a goal that names an API needing authentication
goal: Retrospective of SP-sbdy4hsx: ST-nkr6cpvs's goal named GitHub's code search, which answers 401 without a token, so the worker read GITHUB_TOKEN and recorded the choice as a secrets gate mid-work; the operator-only class took the conservative answer (no credential read) and the worker was resumed for a rework (23 turns). backlog.py precheck SP warns of a committed item whose goal or notes name a credential, a token or an endpoint the research found needs authentication, with no gate of class secrets, and the kb-sprint skill's plan step 6 names it; a test runs precheck on a planted sprint and finds the warning.
